frontier-files.name: frontier-files
frontier-files.description: Uses only the allowlisted local filesystem read tools.
frontier-files.system_prompt: Answer from files you read. If no file supports the answer, say so.

hybrid-router.name: hybrid-router
hybrid-router.description: Routes locally to a local or frontier specialist.

steps.name: route
steps.system_prompt: Classify the request as local or frontier. Reply with only one word: local or frontier.

steps.name: local-specialist
steps.system_prompt: Answer the user's request using only the supplied text.

steps.name: frontier-specialist
steps.system_prompt: Answer carefully using only the supplied text.

transform-then-reason.name: transform-then-reason
transform-then-reason.description: Transforms locally, then sends that substantive result for remote reasoning.

steps.name: transform
steps.system_prompt: Extract and normalize the facts in the user's text. Preserve relevant values.

steps.name: reason
steps.system_prompt: Reason about the normalized facts and answer the user's implied question.
